purpose: Version-bound EmulatorJS runtime selection for 33 Retrom cores, five real Arcade DAT baselines, and reproducible license notice inputs; not mock or scrape metadata

redistribution_policy.note: This manifest records reproducible notice inputs and source provenance; it is not a legal opinion or a grant of redistribution rights.

build_pipeline.source_resolution_note: The official v4.2.3 core reports contain build timestamps but no source commit. Source associations are marked per core: inferred from the build timestamp unless an embedded core Git version was observed at runtime.

dat.generation: release SDL2 build with RELEASEBUILD=1, then fbneo -dat; retained FBNeo_-_Arcade.dat only

materialization.provenance_note: The base snapshot was generated by the upstream libretro automation immediately after the bound EmulatorJS source commit. The two counted byte substitutions reproduce the DAT generated directly from c8c70ba exactly; the final size and SHA-256 remain authoritative. The slower source-build recipe above is the independent audit path.

tested_runtime_override.reason: The official v4.2.3 MAME2003 bundle 2.0.2 aborts during retro_load_game in Chrome 149 for two DAT-valid parent sets. Retrom's smoke fixture therefore pins the closest tested official compatible bundle while retaining the v4.2.3 frontend runtime.
tested_runtime_override.dat_compatibility: metadata/mame2003.xml is byte-identical at the override and v4.2.3 core source commits

dat.compatibility_family: MAME 2003-Plus at the bound core source commit

dat.generation: build the pinned source archive as a native static core, enumerate BurnLibInit/nBurnDrvCount twice in clean temporary directories, and require byte-identical Logiqx XML
